works.title: The Life of Moses
works.subtitle: Classics of Western Spirituality
works.author: Gregory of Nyssa
works.blurb: Gregory reads Moses's ascent of Sinai as the soul's endless ascent into the darkness of God — the seminal text of Eastern mystical theology. Malherbe and Ferguson translation, with preface by John Meyendorff.

works.title: The Origins of the Christian Mystical Tradition
works.subtitle: From Plato to Denys
works.author: Andrew Louth
works.blurb: Louth's classic study of the patristic mystical tradition from Plato and Philo through Origen, Athanasius, Gregory of Nyssa, Evagrius, Macarius, and Augustine to Denys the Areopagite — Nyssa's central place in the upstream of the essence-energies distinction read in its full Eastern context.
